-    #     "GET", "POST", etc.  If the request uses a custom HTTP method, it

-    # .. _`Section 3.4.1.2`: https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc5849#section-3.4.1.2
-    # .. _`Section 3.6`: https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc5849#section-3.6

-    #     being encoded (`Section 3.6`).
-    #
-    # .. _`Sec 3.4.1.3.2`: https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc5849#section-3.4.1.3.2
-    # .. _`Section 3.6`: https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc5849#section-3.6

+def signature_base_string(http_method: str, base_str_uri: str,
+    normalized_encoded_request_parameters: str) ->str:
+    from oauthlib.common import urlencode

+def normalize_parameters(params) ->str:
+    """Normalize parameters according to RFC 5849 section 3.4.1.3.2."""
+    # Sort parameters lexicographically by name
+    sorted_params = sorted(params, key=lambda x: x[0])
+    
+    # Encode each parameter name and value, then join with '='
+    encoded_pairs = []
+    for name, value in sorted_params:
+        encoded_name = utils.escape(name)
+        # Handle None values by converting to empty string
+        if value is None:
+            encoded_value = ''
+        else:
+            encoded_value = utils.escape(value)
+        encoded_pairs.append(f"{encoded_name}={encoded_value}")
+    
+    # Join with '&' characters
+    return "&".join(encoded_pairs)
